Name: Udyam Registration (MSME)
Applicability: All Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

Name: FSSAI Basic Registration
Issuing_Authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
Applicability: Food businesses with turnover < Rs 12 Lakhs (e.g. Nutri-jelly, small juice units)

Name: FSSAI State Licence
Applicability: Food businesses with turnover Rs 12 Lakhs to Rs 20 Crores

Name: GST Registration
Applicability: Mandatory for inter-state sales, or turnover > Rs 40 Lakhs (goods)

Name: APEDA RCMC
Applicability: Mandatory for exporting citrus and processed food products

Name: MPCB Consent to Establish/Operate
Applicability: Processing plants, packing lines generating affluent (Orange/Green category)
